subject: Rate limit elevation request + pro-rated rebate for launch
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin@cloudstitch.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 16:17:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary quota bump + pricing question for upcoming launch

Hi Mina,

Quick situation — we have a product update going live on 2025-07-22 and our projected token volume for the first 72 hours is roughly 3x what we've been using in the last month. We expect most of the traffic to be read-heavy but with a short window of write/generation spikes.

Can Redwood temporarily lift our rate limit / quota for the launch window? Were looking for an uplift that would cover an extra 150% throughput for two weeks (2025-07-20 to 2025-08-03). Also, we wanted to discuss if youd be open to a pro-rated rebate or short-term discount on any overrun tokens if we sign a 3-month committed baseline after the launch.

Procurement will need a PO; I can share that once we have terms. I attached a short forecast (forecast_q3_traffic.csv) so your team can see expected traffic shape.

Thanks — can you confirm whether this is doable and what the price delta would look like (both for an immediate uplift and the rebate mechanics)?

— Erin
Erin Walsh
Head of Product, CloudStitch Labs
E: erin@cloudstitch.com
A: forecast_q3_traffic.csv (attachment)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin@cloudstitch.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary quota bump + pricing question for upcoming launch

Hi Erin — thanks for the heads up and for the forecast.

Short answer: yes, we can support a temporary uplift for the launch window. Proposed approach below so procurement has a clean path:

- Temporary uplift: +150% throughput applied to your existing quota from 2025-07-20 00:00 UTC through 2025-08-03 23:59 UTC.
- Pricing for uplift window: overrun tokens billed at your current pay-as-you-go rate, with an applied pro-rated rebate equal to 25% of overrun charges if you (a) sign a 3-month committed baseline within 7 days of the launch end date and (b) pay the first month of the commitment on invoice arrival.
- PO + invoice timing: we can accept a PO that references this uplift; invoice for the uplift/overrun will follow normal billing cycles but we will apply the rebate as a post-invoice credit within 30 days of commitment confirmation.
- Minimum admin: no contract amendment required for the temporary uplift itself; the 3-month commit will be a short SOW addendum (term sheet attached).

Next steps: 1) confirm youll accept the uplift dates; 2) procurement sends PO referencing deal CS-2025-0947; 3) we provision the uplift and monitor during the window.

Attached: temp-uplift-term-sheet.pdf (proposed short SOW with rebate mechanics and timeline).

Ive looped Ben for pricing oversight and Laura for invoice handling. If procurement needs a slightly different rebate structure (e.g., fixed credit instead of percent), we can review quickly.

Best,

— Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
A: temp-uplift-term-sheet.pdf (attachment)

Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: PO for temporary uplift (PO_CloudStitch_4571.pdf)

Hi Mina / Erin,

Please find attached PO_CloudStitch_4571.pdf — this references the temporary uplift described in Mina's note and includes CloudStitch's standard payment terms (Net 30). We expect Redwood to provision the uplift on 2025-07-20 at 00:00 UTC.

Question: will Redwood invoice the uplift charges as they occur or invoice at month-end? Our accounts payable team prefers consolidated monthly invoices if possible.

Thanks,
CloudStitch Procurement
procurement@cloudstitch.com
A: PO_CloudStitch_4571.pdf (attachment)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Erin Walsh <erin@cloudstitch.com>, procurement@cloudstitch.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: PO for temporary uplift (PO_CloudStitch_4571.pdf) — please approve invoice handling

Laura — forwarding the PO from CloudStitch (attached). Weve agreed to the temporary +150% uplift and a 25% pro-rated rebate on any overrun if they convert to a 3-month commit within 7 days after the uplift window. Procurement asked about invoicing cadence; they prefer consolidated month-end invoices.

Can Revenue Ops accept month-end consolidated billing for the uplift period and apply the rebate as a credit once they sign the commitment? If yes, Ill confirm and queue the provisioning on 2025-07-20. Also included is a DocuSign SOW link for the 3-month commitment if they choose to sign immediately: https://docusign.com/some-doc-id-abc123

Thanks — ccd Ben for pricing oversight.

— Mina
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
